concerns.text: T105/T106 mandate static records carry `injected_state: null`, but the active contract declares `injected_state` as a required `string` (no null). T105's own verification demands schema conformance, so the mandated output cannot satisfy the contract it claims to follow. Either the task must use the schema's 'none' sentinel or the contract must be amended — silently contradicting the contract is a constraint violation.

`consensus_gap_score` is a required field of experiment_log.schema.yaml, but scores are only computed in T109 ('writing scores back into the logs'). T105's verification ('records conforming to contracts/experiment_log.schema.yaml') is unachievable as ordered — the task list silently reorders a contract-mandated field out of the producing task.

concerns.text: T106/T109 exclude `neutral-monitoring` adapter records from the primary comparison. The spec's edge case treats the neutral fallback as valid adapter behavior over the same trajectories, and Principle VII requires comparison 'using the exact same... dialogue trajectories'. Post-hoc dropping of low-confidence adapter runs breaks the pairing and biases toward the adapter — a requirement change the spec never authorized. If exclusion is intended, the spec must be amended to stage it explicitly.

T112 validates `classifier_training_data.json` against `contracts/trajectory.schema.yaml`, but turn-window training records (turn_text/label) are not ConflictTrajectory objects; the 'schema_valid is true' gate is unachievable and the validation pairing contradicts the contract's purpose.

SC-002 (verify the SoCRATES dataset contains emotional-reactivity and cultural-identity variables) has no implementing task; the coverage table lists SC-003 and SC-005 but silently omits SC-002 — a dropped acceptance criterion.

Plan task T028b (validate logged `injected_state` matches the injected instruction template, spec US-2 acceptance scenario 1) was dropped in the re-plan with no replacement; the revision-behavior section claims 'No test or constraint was weakened' but this acceptance criterion has no surviving task.

Plan places scripts under `code/src/{data,models,experiments,analysis}/`; every task references `code/data/generator.py`, `code/experiments/runner.py`, etc. (no `src/`). Implementers following the plan's sanctioned structure will fail the tasks' path-based verifications — the tasks silently diverge from the plan's layout.

data-model.md specifies `data/processed/filtered_trajectories.jsonl` and `emotional_reactivity_score` 0.0–1.0 / `dialogue_history`; T101 writes `trajectories.jsonl` with `emotional_reactivity` 0–10 and `dialogue` per the contract. The data model's referential-integrity constraint points at a file no task produces; align the data model (or note the supersession) so the constraint survives.

FR-002 says the classifier is 'trained on metadata tags'; T103 derives labels from metadata but features from dialogue text windows (matching the plan's 'dynamic text features'). The artifacts disagree on the classifier's inputs, leaving FR-002's independence verification ambiguous — state the resolved interpretation in one place.
